Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF HAEMOSTATIC DRESSING 1. Product type:- Haemostatic dressing for bleeding control. 2. The dressing must contain 100% Chitosan or Kaolin or plant based Sodiu m Carboxymethyl Cellulose or Gelatin + Thrombin. 3. The active agent must carry a net positive charge to enhance haemostati c actively. The active agent must be present on all sides of the dressing. 4. Size:- Width 5 to 8 cms, Length 100 to 150 cms.

5. Dressing must be biocompatible and maintain a pH range of 5 to 7 (pH eq uivalent to most body fluids and tissues). 6. The dressing material should have approx 5 times more absorption capac ity than its weight. 7. The dressing must stop bleeding effectively without causing exothermic r eactions. 8. The dressing must be biocompatible and must not induce skin irritation. 9. Must not release any particles in water or saline, ensuring integrity and s afely during application. 10. Should be used on all traumatic wounds-venous or arterial. 11. No specific technical expertise should be required for application of the d ressing. 12. The dressing should be easily removable without re-bleeding. 13. The dressing should promote immediate biological haemostasis. 14. Dressing must be supplied in a moisture-proof, vaccum-sealed and user-f riendly pack. 15. Dressing should be gamma sterile and accompanied by NABL-accredited test reports & certification. 16. The manufacturing company must possess at least two of the following c ertifications: - (a) Indian Medical Device Rules (b) ISO: 13485:2016 (c) US FDA approval (d) Bureau of Indian Standards (e) CE certification 17. The product inside the packing should have shelf life of minimum 5 years. 18. OEM must provide published clinical evidence supporting the product’s ef ficacy and safety. 19. Manufacturer/OEM should have a market presence of at least 5 years with proven track record. 20. It should preferably be a MII product.
